description: The agent must: (1) Generate `Contract.swift` as a Fluent DataModel conforming to DataModel+ContractFields+Hashable+@unchecked Sendable, using `static let schema = "contracts"`, using `@Parent(key: "created_by") var createdBy: LegalUser` to satisfy the `associatedtype Creator` in the protocol (NOT an existential type), using `@Siblings` for the many-to-many clauses relationship, including timestamps, and critically initializing `contractValidationMessages` as the FIRST statement in every `init()`. (2) Generate `Contract+Schema.swift` with migration name exactly `"contracts-initial"` and a FK referencing `legal_users`. (3) Generate `Contract+Seed.swift` with name `"contracts-seed"`, an idempotency guard (`count() == 0`), and environment-aware branching on `Vapor.Environment.deployment`. (4) Generate a `ContractClause.swift` junction model (NOT UUID arrays) with two `@Parent` properties for Contract and Clause, schema name `contract_clauses`. (5) Generate `ContractClause+Schema.swift` with a unique constraint on both FKs, cascade delete, and `-initial` naming. (6) Generate `ContractFieldsTests.swift` with `@Suite`, `LocalizableTestCase` conformance, `locStore: LocalizationStore`, and critically a `typealias Creator = TestLegalUser` in the private test struct to satisfy the associated type — never using `any LegalUserFields`. (7) Update `database.swift` to register `Contract.Initial()` and `Contract.Seed()`.
